```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
```

```{r}
sim_var_model <- function(c_vec, A_1, A_2, Sigma, T_obs, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  stopifnot(T_obs >= 3)

  K <- length(c_vec)
  Y <- matrix(0, nrow = T_obs, ncol = K)

  epsilon <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = T_obs, mu = rep(0, K), Sigma = Sigma)

  # Unconditional mean of the stable VAR(2)
  mu <- solve(diag(K) - A_1 - A_2, c_vec)
  Y[1, ] <- MASS::mvrnorm(1, mu, Sigma)
  Y[2, ] <- MASS::mvrnorm(1, mu, Sigma)

  for (t in 3:T_obs) {
    Y[t, ] <- c_vec + A_1 %*% Y[t - 1, ] + A_2 %*% Y[t - 2, ] + epsilon[t, ]
  }
  Y
}

T_obs <- 200
c_vec <- c(2.5, 1.5)
A_1 <- matrix(c(0.45, -0.15,
                -0.35, 0.30), nrow = 2)
A_2 <- matrix(c(0.05, -0.05,
                -0.05, 0.03), nrow = 2)
Sigma <- matrix(c(1.0, 0.1,
                  0.1, 1.0), nrow = 2)

Y <- sim_var_model(c_vec, A_1, A_2, Sigma, T_obs, seed = 1) |>
  scale()

stan_data <- list(
  T        = nrow(Y),
  N        = ncol(Y),
  Y        = Y,
  p        = 2,
  xi_split = c(4, 4),
  xi_own   = rep(1, 4),
  xi_cross = rep(1, 4),
  mean_R2  = 0.666,
  prec_R2  = 3,
  sigma_sd = 2
)
```

```{r}
mod_arr2 <- cmdstan_model(
  "models/var-arr2.stan",
  stanc_options = list("O1", "warn-pedantic" = TRUE)
)

fit_arr2 <- mod_arr2$sample(
  data = stan_data,
  parallel_chains = 4,
  refresh = 0,
  show_messages = FALSE,
  show_exceptions = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
fit_arr2$diagnostic_summary()
fit_arr2$summary(c("alpha", "A", "sigma", "R2", "w"))
```
